correctness.rationale: For every finite-dimensional nilpotent L with 2-dimensional abelianization the equality H∩[L,L]=[H,H] for the image H of an idempotent endomorphism forces projected rank 0/1/2 to correspond to ordinary ranks 0/1/n via nilpotent Frattini generation. Each quotient rank-one projection has exactly |[L,L]|=q^(n−2) homomorphic idempotent lifts. Two distinct rank-one lifts commute exactly for complementary quotient projections, in which case both composites vanish. The graph, counts, clique polynomial and limit follow exactly, with no missing characteristic restriction. Direct enumerator reproduces all eight cases; finite tests are not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Inspected strongest published same-category result for free class-two Lie algebras, which covers the Heisenberg specialization but not all two-generated nilpotent algebras. A prior finite-exponent-prime group result has the same d=2 bipartite graph and quotient-lifting mechanism, so these ideas and the graph shape are credited as known cross-category precedent. That group theorem does not directly imply the current ordinary Lie classification for arbitrary finite fields and classes at least p beyond usual Lazard transfer. The substantive new assertion is the all-class all-quotient Lie universality with graph reconstruction/blindness. Publication priority remains qualified; the older free Lie retract article is not fully inspected.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a genuine bracket-blind structural classification for every two-generated finite-dimensional nilpotent Lie algebra of every nilpotency class, not just the previously counted free class-two case; it also recovers field size and dimension from the graph, establishes a four-map Boolean maximal commuting law, and pinpoints failure of the graph to recover Lie isomorphism/class using nonisomorphic dimension-five examples. This gives natural information-content boundaries for an algebraic invariant and complete, reusable finite-field formulas.
